sources.title: Certo v1: Local VRAM and Hardware Fit - madebyagents.com
sources.snippet: What makes Certo v1 interesting is how it was trained. AltSlate built a synthetic world with a known correct answer and trained the model against the exact posterior using soft, distributional targets — 60k examples, 25 epochs. Calibration isn't a post-hoc temperature fit here; it's the training objective.
